name: Get the status of an action run
description: Get the status of an action run Returns the current status of the specified action run. GET /v1/projects/{ref}/actions/{run_id}

name: Get the logs of an action run
description: Get the logs of an action run Returns the logs from the specified action run. GET /v1/projects/{ref}/actions/{run_id}/logs
context:
GET /v1/projects/{ref}/actions/{run_id}/logs
Returns the logs from the specified action run.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref; run_id (path) — Action Run ID

name: List all action runs
description: List all action runs Returns a paginated list of action runs of the specified project. GET /v1/projects/{ref}/actions
context:
GET /v1/projects/{ref}/actions
Returns a paginated list of action runs of the specified project.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref
Optional: offset (query); limit (query)

name: Update the status of an action run
description: Update the status of an action run Updates the status of an ongoing action run. PATCH /v1/projects/{ref}/actions/{run_id}/status
context:
PATCH /v1/projects/{ref}/actions/{run_id}/status
Updates the status of an ongoing action run.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref; run_id (path) — Action Run ID; body (body)
